# Aqara Developer
> 面向开发者的 Aqara 文档索引，涵盖云 API、Studio API 与数据模型规范。

## 推荐优先阅读
- 概览: https://docs.aqara.com/zh/docs/aqara-developer/introduction
- AIOT API 简介: https://docs.aqara.com/zh/docs/aqara-developer/aiot-api/introduction
- 简介: https://docs.aqara.com/zh/docs/aqara-developer/data-export-api/introduction
- 核心概念: https://docs.aqara.com/zh/docs/aqara-developer/aqara-data-model-specification/core-concepts
